name: Kapori
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.verdict: a source was named but could not be reached
earlier_scan.source_named: Rumaropen, Benny (2006). Survey Report on the Kapauri Language of Papua, Indonesia. Unpublished ms., SIL Indonesia.

sources.citation: Menanti, Jacqualine and Ben Rumaropen. 2022. Survey Report on the Kapauri Language of Papua, Indonesia. Journal of Language Survey Reports 2022-026. SIL International. 69 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Sociolinguistic rapid-appraisal survey (fieldwork May 2006); the words stress/accent/syllable/tone (as prosody) do not occur. Appendix B (pdf p.30ff) gives a 239-item Kapauri (Pagai) wordlist in field IPA; only 9 Kapauri items carry a stress mark, at varying positions (34 'ˈmohuly', 50 'ˈsutaɽinɪ', 79 'sukuˈkaka', 136 'biˈnɛ', 190 'maˈnʊnʊ', 203 'tɪtɪˈmɪnɪ', 183 'janˈtĩʔ'); p.23 (pdf p.29): the wordlist data and texts 'are field transcriptions and have not undergone phonological and grammatical analysis'. Appendix C sentences (pdf pp.55-58) have no stress marks.
Nothing; 38 lexical items from Voorhoeve 1975 only.
